messages:
micah: Quick sync — Q2 sprint checkpoint for dedicated capacity lifecycle. Need final decisions on: 1) burst preemption window (30m vs 2h), 2) soft-spill behavior for reserved pools, 3) autoscale cooldowns for canary customers. Can we decide by EOD Wed? :calendar:

 aisha: I'm leaning 30m for preemption window for latency-sensitive customers. 2h feels too long for noisy tenants.

 jordan (product): We have three pilot customers who require <100ms p50 SLA and reserved burst credits — they prefer shorter preemption but want guaranteed minimum tokens. Propose: 30m default + per-customer override in contract.

 neha: Agreement. Also want to add an opt-in "grace carryover" for unused burst credits (pilot only) — keeps churn lower.

 ryan: Ops note: soft-spill has a DB-heavy control plane path. If we add per-customer overrides + carryover, we need a migration plan. Estimate +3 dev days and a schema migration.

 alex (ops): Also need to define eviction feedback: when we preempt, send event to metrics and customer webhook. Current event payload is minimal — add fields: pool_id, preempt_duration, reason. Example:
```
{ "pool_id": "rp-123", "duration": "30m", "reason": "preempt_for_higher_tier" }
```

 deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: dedicated-capacity-service@canary-2026-03-18

 micah: OK tradeoffs noted. Proposal to ship MVP for pilot: 30m preemption, soft-spill enable default, no carryover in MVP, per-customer overrides planned for rollout 2.0. Launch criteria: docs, JSON webhook events, automated e2e test for preemption, 95% canary pass. Who can own the migration plan?

 ryan: I can own migration + schema. Will need a small migration window and rollback script.

 neha: I'll draft contract language for per-customer override and grace-carryover as future add-on.

 jordan (product): Please add checklist items: SLA doc update, pricing note (burst credits), console UX for override toggle, and customer-facing email template.

 micah: Cool. Action items:
- ryan: migration plan & rollback by Tue
- neha: contract + external comms draft by Wed
- alex: webhook schema + metrics event by Tue
- eng: e2e test PR by Thu
- product: finalize pilot customer checklist

 micah: If anyone blocks on time, flag here. Otherwise we'll lock the sprint scope tonight. :lock:

 aisha: ack, aligned.

 ryan: will tag PRs and ping when migrations are scheduled.

 deploy-bot: incident-alert: none

 micah: Thanks — closing sync.
